name: Wilds of the Realmwalker
detailed_description:
Enter a magical world of spellcraft, survival, and exploration in Wilds of the Realmwalker, a 1 -4 player cooperative adventure where you and your magical companion uncover secrets, restore ruins, and build across wild, mystical realms. As a Realmwalker, master elemental magic, traverse Spellgates, and team up to survive, craft, and create cozy memories. From lush ruins to molten lava flows, discover the Wilds together!

Core Gameplay

  • Cooperative Survival

    • Gather resources, manage hunger, stamina, and survive the elements while journeying through the diverse wilds

  • Magic and Spellcrafting

    • Channel elemental magic to build, fight, and explore. Customize your spellbook with crafted spells and arcane tools

  • Exploration and Discovery

    • Traverse the mysterious Wilds through ancient Spellgates. Each realm offers unique biomes, resources, enemies, and secrets to uncover.

  • Building and Crafting

    • Build Shelters, crafting stations, and mystical contraptions. Shape your surroundings and prepare for the unknown.

  • Mystical Companions

    • Every team is joined by a magical creature that grows alongside them. Personalize your wizard, gea,r and companion to suit your playstyle.

  • Restoration and Worldbuilding

    • Discover ruins and restoration sites where you bring ancient magic back to life and unlock hidden lore

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Core i5-7200U @ 2.50GHz or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated GPU with 4GB VRAM (e.g., NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 Ti or equivalent)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated or dedicated sound card
  • VR Support: Not supported
  • Additional Notes: SSD is strongly recommended for a smoother experience
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-9700K or AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1660 Super or AMD Radeon RX 580 (6GB+ VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated or dedicated sound card
  • VR Support: Not supported
  • Additional Notes: A mid-tier gaming laptop or desktop from the last 3–4 years is ideal
